title: The Bridge of Manchester's mill district
author: Emrys Ashgrove
blurb: Bram Ishikawa, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
